nodes.label: small transformer
nodes.definition: A small transformer is a model architecture that utilizes self-attention mechanisms and backpropagation for training.

nodes.label: self attention
nodes.definition: Self-attention is a mechanism used to process text within the small transformer.

nodes.label: text
nodes.definition: Text is the input data processed by the self-attention mechanism of the small transformer.

nodes.label: backpropagation
nodes.definition: Backpropagation is a method used to improve predictions during the training phase of the small transformer.

nodes.label: predictions of the small transformer
nodes.definition: Predictions are outputs generated by the small transformer that are improved via backpropagation during training.

nodes.label: training
nodes.definition: Training is the phase during which the small transformer uses backpropagation to improve its predictions.

nodes.label: regularization
nodes.definition: A technique applied to models to improve generalization.

nodes.label: training examples of the small transformer
nodes.definition: The specific data instances used by the small transformer for its training process.

nodes.label: quantization
nodes.definition: The process of reducing memory requirements after training.

nodes.label: memory requirements of the small transformer
nodes.definition: The amount of memory needed by the small transformer to operate.

nodes.label: retrieval augmented generation
nodes.definition: A technique allowing the use of external documents for answering questions.

nodes.label: external documents
nodes.definition: Documents used to support answers in retrieval-augmented generation.

nodes.label: attention weights
nodes.definition: Attention weights that quantify the relevance of one token to another.

nodes.label: gradients of loss function
nodes.definition: Gradients of loss function indicate the direction and magnitude by which model parameters should be adjusted.

nodes.label: overfitting
nodes.definition: The phenomenon where a model performs well on training data but poorly on unseen data.

nodes.label: retriever component
nodes.definition: A component that fetches relevant context from external documents.

nodes.label: generator component
nodes.definition: A component that conditions its output on the context fetched by the retriever to generate answers.

provenance.text: A small transformer uses self-attention to process text and backpropagation to improve its predictions during training. Regularization helps it generalize beyond its training examples. After training, quantization reduces its memory requirements, while retrieval-augmented generation lets it use external documents when answering questions.
